title: Linear Self-Attention
hint: Feature map: phi(x) = elu(x) + 1. Compute phi(Q) @ (phi(K)^T @ V) instead of softmax(Q @ K^T) @ V. Normalize by phi(Q) @ sum(phi(K)).

description.text: Implement linear self-attention via a kernel/feature map φ: rewrite attention as φ(Q)(φ(K)^T V) so you avoid forming the full N×N attention matrix—useful for long sequences when φ is chosen appropriately.

constraints: Use PyTorch only unless task says otherwise.
